memberdef.name: XPM_STRICT_CHECK_IF_NULL
memberdef.initializer: ({ \ volatile const TYPE *RET2 = (NULL); \ RET1 = (NULL); \ STSTMP = XST_FAILURE; \ RET1 = (TYPE *)(FUNC(__VA_ARGS__)); \ RET2 = (TYPE *)(FUNC(__VA_ARGS__)); \ if (((NULL) == RET1) && ((NULL) == RET2)) { \ STSTMP = XST_SUCCESS; \ } \ STSTMP; \ })

briefdescription.para: Adds redundancy while comparing the return value of called function.

detaileddescription.para: based on NULL == RHS comparison wants to skip some part from execution. This is to avoid glitches from altering the return values of security critical functions. The macro requires a label to be passed to "go to". This MACRO will require when need to strictly check for && as per the implementation.

Variable to store the return value of function to be execute at at RHS during comparison. Type of pointer which returns by the function to be execute at RHS during comparison. The function to be execute at RHS during comparison.
Other
params are arguments to the called function
XST_SUCCESS if condition become true else XST_FAILURE

briefdescription.para: Verify a previous register write by reading the register back and comparing only the bits selected by MASK against VAL.

parameterdescription.para: Address of the register to read back.
Bitmask selecting the bits to compare.
Expected value (only MASK bits are compared).
Status variable; set to XPM_REG_WRITE_FAILED on mismatch.
